definitions.explanation: A thoroughly bad or wicked person. Someone who commits evil deeds or engages in criminal or immoral behavior. Stronger than mere mischief — implies genuine malice or villainy.

examples.japanese: ⟦あいつ→あいつ：08267_aitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悪党|あくとう}だ。
{悪党|あくとう}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支配|しはい}している→支配する：25222_shihaisuru⟧。
examples.english: A gang of villains controls this town.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}た{目|め}→見た目：14110_mitame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{紳士|しんし}→紳士：18022_shinshi⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悪党|あくとう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られていた→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He looked like a gentleman, but behind the scenes he was known as a scoundrel.

notes:
USAGE:
{悪党|あくとう} refers to a genuinely bad or evil person. It is commonly used in fiction, historical dramas, and storytelling. In everyday speech, it carries a strong negative judgment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}{悪党|あくとう}: a great villain, arch-villain
- {悪党|あくとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一味|いちみ}→一味：11238_ichimi⟧: a gang of villains
- {悪党|あくとう}{面|づら}: a villainous face

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {悪党|あくとう}: villain, scoundrel (genuine evil or criminality)
- ⟦{悪者|わるもの}→悪者：29398_warumono⟧: bad guy (broader, milder — includes petty wrongdoers)
- ⟦{悪人|あくにん}→悪人：29116_akunin⟧: evil person (literary, emphasizes moral wickedness)
